steps.name: fix-only-shared-test-helper-for-Ionic-card-and-commit-slice
steps.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
echo 'EXPECTED_DIRTY_FILES';git status --short
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('apps/mobile/src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx')
s=p.read_text()
a="""const openShellyBleScanFromSettings = async () => {
  fireEvent.click(
    screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Skanuj termometry BLE przez to gniazdko' })
  );
};"""
b="""const openShellyBleScanFromSettings = async () => {
  fireEvent.click(getIonicButton(document, 'Skanuj termometry BLE przez to gniazdko'));
};"""
assert s.count(a)==1
assert 'getIonicButton' in s
p.write_text(s.replace(a,b))
PY
pnpm exec prettier --write apps/mobile/src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec vitest run src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx --reporter=dot >/tmp/shelly-ionic-card-ble-177-focused.log 2>&1 || {echo FOCUSED_TEST_FAILED;grep -E 'FAIL|Error|×|Test Files|Tests ' /tmp/shelly-ionic-card-ble-177-focused.log|tail -65||true;tail -45 /tmp/shelly-ionic-card-ble-177-focused.log;exit 33;}
grep -E 'Test Files|Tests ' /tmp/shelly-ionic-card-ble-177-focused.log | tail -5
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile typecheck
git diff --check
git add apps/mobile/src/screens/hardware-setup/pages/ShellySetupPresentation.tsx apps/mobile/src/theme/theme.css apps/mobile/src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx
git commit -m "refactor(ionic): saved Shelly BLE card scan as compact Ionic action"
git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/work/ux-evolution
echo "COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
git status --short
